case_selection: First unused completed AM and PM editions following the prior 2026-09-23 AM evaluation. Fixed before reading source titles or bodies. These are unseen editions; overlapping originals are counted separately.
source_selection: Same bounded cached-original SQL selection as inputs.collect: 30 hours, at most 48 articles per origin, 600 total, then unchanged selection v3. No retrospective current lake values, search or calendar fetch.
pass: All twelve semantic checks true, verdict publish, no mechanical rejection, complete core observations, no unresolved quote conflict. All first attempts and one possible repair retained.
repair: Only one after a confirmed failure, using the service mechanically accepted draft and combined rejections. Offline replay does not qualify live timing. No uncertain replay.
latency: Record actual writer, review, repair and final-review seconds. Compare their sum with 20-minute nominal and 30-minute final window; excludes queue and collection.
change_reason: The completed AM one-repair trial passed factual/content checks but repeated the alternative already in interpretation. Format 8 renders primary mechanism plus alternative once, moves application interpretation to detail, labels Korean holidays, and tells review to record style problems as failed checks rather than fact rejection. No new sources or rewriting of AM provider output.
evaluation_scope: The initial four-call AM trial is closed as failed. One additional review of the unchanged repaired output rendered in format 8 is a separate technical development check. PM first inference uses the same frozen sources and format-8 procedure; no prior PM inference has run.
